Subject: Vendor master setup: Tilera Labs — legal name & PO contact

Hi Liam,

Thanks for the call earlier. We're ready to create Tilera Labs in our vendor master so we can route POs and process the first invoice. To get the record created cleanly, can you please confirm the following and send any supporting docs you have?

- Legal/registered entity name (exact)
- Tax ID / EIN (masked is fine in email, full on secure upload)
- Registered address (street, city, state, country)
- Remittance address (if different)
- Preferred PO contact (name, email, phone) and AP invoicing address (email where AP receives invoices)
- Payment method preference (ACH / wire) and ACH instructions (bank name + account ending) — if you'd rather, you can attach a PDF with bank details.

I've attached our vendor_onboarding_template.pdf to speed things up. If we can get these by end of day Friday 3/19, procurement will create the payee and route an initial PO.

Thanks — copying Jordan (procurement) so we can action as soon as we have the docs.

Best,

Mina Haddad
Senior Vendor Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: vendor_onboarding_template.pdf (pdf)]

Liam — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. I've reviewed the docs and filled in your details on our onboarding form — attached as vendor_onboarding_response.pdf. A few quick items before I kick off the NetSuite record creation: 

- Can you confirm that invoices should be sent to invoices@tilera.com (we will CC AP when we send the PO).
- We store a remit address per vendor. You confirmed it's the same as registered — final confirm?
- For ACH, we need a confirmation of account ending (we only capture last 4 digits in NetSuite) — can you confirm the last 4 digits are 1124? If you prefer, we can accept the bank letter via secure upload.

Once you confirm the two items above I'll create the payee and route approval. Marissa, looping you for Finance intake so we can map the supplier to the correct GL and payment terms.
